serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Vanta Government Cloud is an end-to-end security and compliance platform powered by AI and automation. From continuous governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) and vendor risk management to questionnaire automation and Trust Center visibility, Vanta helps organizations streamline compliance across 35+ frameworks - including SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, NIST 800-53. NIST CSF, CMMC, and more. With over 16,000 customers, Vanta is the continuous monitoring solution that helps organizations achieve and maintain a strong security posture.
